description.value:
Tsunami Defense Systems is known best for its elite and dizzyingly expensive sniper rifles, but more of the Japanese company's products are beginning to gain traction on Night City's streets. Take their flagship pistol, the Nue, for example. Unlike the Ashura or Nekomata, the Nue's design is not founded on any bleeding-edge technologies. But what it lacks in innovation, it makes up for in workmanship. The only debatable flaw is a size that can prove difficult to conceal. Still... Who would ever want to hide such a masterpiece?

Cost: 1,200eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Excellent Quality Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6). This weapon incurs a -2 penalty to Conceal/Reveal Object Checks made to conceal it underneath clothing.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
